description: This file contains an immutable implementation of LogicalSearchFilter, specifically the class ImmutableLogicalFilter, which provides static methods to create logical filters (NOT, AND, OR) for search filtering in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableLogicalFilter
classes.description: An immutable implementation of LogicalSearchFilter that provides static factory methods for logical filter creation (not, and, or).

methods.name: not
methods.description: Creates a negation (NOT) filter from a given SearchFilter.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Creates an AND logical filter from two or more SearchFilters.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Creates an OR logical filter from two or more SearchFilters.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the logical filter (NOT, AND, OR).

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns the collection of SearchFilters contained in this logical filter.
